question: As of 30th November 2020, how many countries are members of the International Monetary Fund (IMF)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**190**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **190 countries** are **members of the International Monetary Fund **(IMF).
 
• The **IMF **is a **global organization **that aims to p**romote international monetary cooperation and exchange rate stability**.
 
• Member countries contribute to the **IMF's resources** and have **voting rights proportional to their financial contributions**.
 
• The** IMF provides financial assistance to member countries facing balance of payments problems**.
 
• It also conducts **economic surveillance and provides policy advice** to its member countries to **promote economic stability and growth**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Monetary Fund (IMF)**

 
 
• The IMF was** established in 1944 **during the **Bretton Woods Conference** in **New Hampshire, United States**.
 
• **IMF Headquarters**- **Washington, D.C**.
 
• It was created to promote **international monetary cooperation and exchange rate stabilit**y.
 
• Initially, its primary focus was on **managing the international monetary system based on fixed exchange rates**.
 
• It has played a significant role in **stabilizing economies, promoting economic growth, and reducing poverty worldwide**.
